purpose: Pre-register interpretation protocol for t20_a075_s42_fp32 BEFORE results arrive. Prevents post-hoc narrative fitting.

A_t_invariance.interpretation: T-invariance confirmed across ALL tested α levels. Detection is α-threshold-driven; T=10 already captures asymptotic regime. Signal saturation at T=10 means 6/8 structural ceiling (2 mauve true nulls) applies universally.
A_t_invariance.paper_action: Full T-invariance narrative. S×R: signal is α-driven, T provides estimation sample size. T=10 sufficiency directly rebuts 'T=11 too short' reviewer concern.

B_partial_power_gain.interpretation: Power gain observed at α=0.75 (transitional regime) but not at α=0.50/1.0 (saturated regime). At α=0.50, 6/8 ceiling is structural. At α=0.75, one or more borderline pairs cross FDR threshold with doubled sequence length. Hybrid: T-invariance in strong-signal regime + √T gain in transitional regime.
B_partial_power_gain.paper_action: Nuanced narrative: 'Detection rate is T-stable in the saturated regime (α≥0.50 at T=10), with marginal √T-driven power gain near the onset boundary (α=0.75). T=10 is sufficient for contamination levels above the detection onset.'
B_partial_power_gain.strength: Still supports T-sufficiency for practical detection; adds nuance about transitional regime

C_unexpected_regression.interpretation: Unexpected. Possible causes: (1) seed effect (s42 at α=0.75 T=10 was 6/8, but s44 was 0/8 — high variance); (2) T=20 introduces additional non-stationarity that degrades PermG; (3) data quality issue. Requires investigation before any narrative commitment.
C_unexpected_regression.paper_action: Report with investigation. Do NOT commit to T-invariance or √T narrative until root cause is understood. Flag as limitation if seed-driven.

decision_rule: Scenario selection is deterministic based on PermG count. No post-hoc reinterpretation allowed. If PermG=4, treat as Scenario A (within noise of 5/8 T=10 baseline given high seed variance at α=0.75).
